license_summary.trapping_license: Trapping license required (resident 16+ $36; nonresident 16+ $318; junior/apprentice available). Resident landowners and immediate family may trap without a license on their own contiguous 10+ acre land where they live. Children under 10 trap without a license (not bear). License year July 1-June 30.
license_summary.beaver_nonresident: U.S. nonresidents may trap beaver only if their home state allows Maine residents to trap beaver; non-U.S. citizens may trap in Maine only for beaver and only with provincial reciprocity.
license_summary.harvest_reports: Trappers 16+ (incl. lifetime license holders) must complete fall and spring harvest reports even if they did not trap (due Jan 31 / May 31).
license_summary.tagging: Bobcat and otter must be tagged by Department personnel. Biological samples required: lower jaw/tooth from every bobcat, fisher, marten, and otter, plus a tissue sample from bobcats.

verification.confirmation_notes: 2026-2027 MDIFW trapping lawbook (final). Season table p.4: early raccoon/fox/coyote Oct 18-31 statewide (raccoon NEW for 2026-27); early muskrat Oct 25-31 in WMDs 1-6 & 9-11; beaver WMDs 1-4 Oct 18-Apr 30, WMDs 5,6,8-11 Oct 25-Apr 30, WMDs 7,12-29 Oct 25-Apr 15; general trapping Nov 1-Dec 31 statewide (bobcat, coyote, fisher, fox, marten, mink, muskrat, opossum, otter, raccoon, red squirrel, skunk, weasel); fisher/marten bag 25 each (p.12); lynx no open season (p.14); wolf extirpated/no season (p.15); beaver town-level closures pp.20-21 with Perkins Twp. (Swan Island, WMD 22) fully closed; late muskrat rules p.11 (beaver-open areas only; post-Feb-28 method restrictions); otter Jan 1-Apr 30 registration rule p.12; hunting prohibitions for beaver/fisher/marten/mink/muskrat/otter/weasel p.5.
known_gaps: HUNTING seasons for furbearers (bobcat, coyote, red/gray fox, opossum, raccoon, red squirrel, skunk) are published in the separate Maine Summary of Hunting Laws, not in this trapping lawbook — hunting methods are NOT YET included for Maine.
Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in the lawbook; all marked scientific_name_verified=false.
Beaver town/property-level closures (pp.20-21) are carried as a warning, not modeled as zones; Perkins Twp. (Swan Island) full closure is modeled via zone note.
Black bear trapping (Sept 1-Oct 31, permit required) is excluded as big game, not a furbearer — consistent with the furbearer scope of this dataset.
No administrative-code (CMR) cross-check performed; the MDIFW lawbook is the published season authority.
